If I'm revising, I like to have a bit of a scratchy feeling on the paper but can't use a sharpie pen because it will undoubtedly leak through, so I use a ball point pen. I've always been like this, and thus, I've always felt a void in my pen life. I've always been pissing the perfect pen for every day use. I've gotten close on a few occasions. I'm quite fond of the Bic Grip Roller pens, because of how smoothly they write and the way the ink looks when it's flowing from pen to paper, but there was something missing.

One day I was preparing to sign and date an IV when I realized my badge must have come off at the nurses's station. I asked the nearest person for a pen, and someone gladly handed me one of these Pentel EnerGel Deluxe pens. I noticed immediately, even on tape, how smoothly and boldly and continuously this pen wrote. I remembered the name and bought myself a set the next day. This pen is my every day pen. Every other pen I have ever bought seems lacking compared to these. The colours are beautiful and vibrant on any colour paper and most textures. They dry surprisingly quickly. Because of how shiny the writing is, you might be hesitant to wipe your hand across the surface, but try it. Chances are that by the time you're finished writing, the ink has already dried.

Furthermore, it doesn't leak nearly as much as you'd expect. It has a metal tip, which you can't control as well as a needle tip, but as long as you don't stab the point to the paper, you won't leak through to the other side. The ink feels like it wants to come out of the pen, so pushing it lightly up against the paper gives you perfect control and a perfectly steady stream. Once you get used to barely touching the paper with this pen, you'll soon realize how much this speeds along the process. If you do a lot of manual writing, your wrist will cramp less, your hands will get less tired, and it'll feel like you're waving your hand through the air rather than putting pen to paper.

These pens are incredible. Once you use them, you will never want to use another pen regularly again. The ink, the feel, the colours, etc. All of it is perfection. t: The pen you dont let out of your hands!
x: I have been using these pens for years now, and don't like to use anything else. If I lend one to someone else at work, I always have to keep a close eye on it because everyone loves the way they feel and write so much that they don't want to give them back! They write very smoothly and evenly. I have never had any trouble with ink not coming out or writing unevenly (unless the cartridge is almost out of ink). I have only had problems with blotching a few times in all my years of daily use, and I think those were due to faulty ink cartridges. I like the medium tip the best- 0.7mm- (I tried a finer tip once and didn't like the way it looked as much). The weight of the pens in my hand is what I consider about a medium weight- they aren't heavy like a fancy metal pen, but it also doesn't feel like you're writing with a feather. I like the feel of the grip, and it makes writing nice and comfortable. I also appreciate the clip on the end of the pen, as I like to clip these onto my pocket at work. The clip is metal and quite sturdy- I have never had any issues with it breaking or coming off. Before you start writing with these, there is a tiny dot of something like dried glue on the tip of the pen that you need to remove- I assume this is there to help keep the ink fresh. I only buy these pens every few years and buy ink refills in the meantime when they run out of inkPentel Refill Ink for BL57/BL77 EnerGel Liquid Gel Pen, Box of 12, 0.7mm, Metal Tip, Black Ink (LR7-A-12) . After a while I do need to buy new pens, as they start to crack where the two halves of the pen screw together and so have a tendency to fall apart when you're writing with them. But again, this is after constant daily use for a few years time. I highly recommend these pens, but warn that after trying these you may not want to use any other pens ever again!

t: I'm loyal to the Pentel EnerGel pens; not a new purchase
x:
I have been using Pentel EnerGel pens for a few years now; these are the best for mutli-coloured writing and the 0.5mm metal alloy body with refillable ink is my favourite pen for under $20. I ordered the 12 pack of colours but I have used these before in all of the colours except the brown-ish shade. I keep buying these pens because they are fairly sturdy with a nice grip, the ink flows smoothly and dries in an instant and each shade displays vibrant colour/pigment with one line (I will add another photo showing the colours after opening them). The price seems higher when compared to other products at drug stores or Walmart but the cost is more than fair when compared to other specialized writing utensils that perform on the same level. I wish they had an option for this set in the 0.5mm size as opposed to the 0.7 because the larger width only pronounces my poor penmanship ;) Otherwise these are great and you'll be surprised at how many seem to "disappear" after letting someone borrow one.
Shipping was good as I chose the set available with Prime delivery and it was accused in a box with another item that protected them. I'd worry if they were alone in a plastic bag like many of my items have been shipped lately.
